This page presents between-tool benchmarking of single-locus amino acid allele frequency estimates. Single-locus microhaplotype allele frequency is benchmarked [here](freq_single_microhaplotype.qmd). The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd). All estimates on this page use the full, 165-target MAD^4^HatTeR panel.

The tools are [naive single-locus allele frequency](../tutorials/PGEcore/naive_single_AF/background.Rmd), the [incomplete data model](../tutorials/IDM/background.Rmd), and [dcifer](../tutorials/dcifer/dcifer_background.Rmd).

For each tool, tool comparisons are made with the parameter set with the highest Lin's CCC.

```{r}
#| include: false
bench_src <- c("benchmark_data.R", file.path("benchmarking", "benchmark_data.R"))
source(bench_src[file.exists(bench_src)][1])
variant_freq <- single_variant_results()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Estimated frequency versus simulated frequency. The line is equality."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
plot_frequency(variant_freq)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute error within each population, in simulated-frequency bins of 0.2."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_frequency_mae(variant_freq, variant_colours, variant_tool_order)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  variant_freq$metrics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and detection for the best parameter set for each tool. Detection is the share of alleles simulated at 1% or above whose estimate is above 0."
)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  variant_freq$by_freq,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "The same summaries binned by simulated frequency. Detection is not defined for alleles simulated below 1%."
)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  variant_freq$by_mean,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "The same summaries by mean-COI category."
)
```
